facts.label: Note
facts.value: Stands outside the maze wall, on the hill in a square wall ~8 m, in the west arm of the T (S604's 320 m reaches it). Hill survives as today's pine mound. Plate 5 shows only trees and hill behind the hall. Its parent CC22 is right; XY04 is not. The id misleads: note, never renumber. (S01;S604, Round 6).
